final_diagnosis.root_cause: The currencyservice deployment in the boutique namespace has a pod stuck in ErrImagePull because the kubelet cannot pull the referenced container image. This is a configuration fault in the image reference or registry credentials, isolated to this one service.
final_diagnosis.report:
The currencyservice deployment in the boutique namespace has a pod stuck in ErrImagePull because the kubelet cannot pull the referenced container image

## Findings
• The boutique namespace has exactly one failing workload: currencyservice.
• The failing pod currencyservice-b68d5576c-gbl9k is in ErrImagePull state at ~30s old.
• The currencyservice Deployment shows 0/1 ready, 0 available, desired 1.
• All 10 other Online Boutique pods are 1/1 Running with 0 restarts.
• The failure mode is image pull, not crash loop, OOM, readiness probe failure, or scheduling issue.

*Non-Validated Claims (Inferred):*
• The exact image reference being pulled by the currencyservice deployment.
• Whether the underlying cause is a bad tag, nonexistent repository, or missing/expired imagePullSecret.
• Whether ErrImagePull has since progressed to ImagePullBackOff.
• Whether a recent deploy bumped the image tag to a value not present in the registry.

## Recommended Actions
• Run 'kubectl -n boutique describe pod currencyservice-b68d5576c-gbl9k' and inspect Events for the exact 'Failed to pull image' message.
• Retrieve the configured image via 'kubectl -n boutique get deploy currencyservice -o jsonpath={.spec.template.spec.containers[*].image}' and verify the tag exists in the registry.
• If the tag is invalid, roll back with 'kubectl -n boutique rollout undo deployment/currencyservice' or patch to a known-good image via 'kubectl -n boutique set image deploy/currencyservice server=<good-image:tag>'.
• If the error is unauthorized/denied, verify and recreate the imagePullSecrets referenced by the deployment/service account and confirm kubelet registry (e.g., ECR) credentials are valid.
• Monitor recovery with 'kubectl -n boutique rollout status deploy/currencyservice' and confirm the pod reaches Running 1/1; validate end-to-end via the frontend currency conversion flow.
• Add a CI gate that runs 'docker manifest inspect' on images before promotion and an alert on kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason=~ErrImagePull|ImagePullBackOff.


*Cited Evidence:*
- Queries: GetAlerts, list eks pods, list eks deployments, get eks events, DescribeResource, GetAppYAML, GetResources, GetErrorLogs, GetRecentLogs, get hermes logs, get sre guidance


Timing: 80s
